title: FPS increases for every opened window in Compatibility, causing high GPU usage
body:
### Tested versions

Tested in 4.4.1 and 4.3 stable

### System information

Godot v4.4.1.stable - Windows 11 (build 26100) - Multi-window, 1 monitor - OpenGL 3 (Compatibility) - NVIDIA GeForce GTX 1060 3GB (NVIDIA; 32.0.15.6636) - 12th Gen Intel(R) Core(TM) i5-12600K (16 threads)

### Issue description

I am working on a file manager in godot and I noticed when opening ~15-20 windows, all the windows lagged immensely (ui inside the windows as well as moving them around). Using Rivatuner, I noticed that the FPS becomes higher and higher the more windows that are opened. I then realized similar behavior occurs with the editor for more windows. I think this only happens in compatibility as forward+ seems to behave as expected.

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/542038e6-6db7-469c-8cf3-3a4704a6fa34)

![Image](https://github.com/user-attachments/assets/9ad6b874-ef00-4ab5-9ade-8d7de250c890)

After this, I created a MRP, which seems to lag to a lesser degree, but still has the same issue where the fps becomes ridiculously high and it takes a massive toll on the gpu even if the scene is empty. The weird thing is that the engine doesnt report the higher fps so I might have been mislead by rivatuner. Nonetheless the gpu usage is very high.

### Steps to reproduce

run the scene in the mrp project. make sure its in compatibility

[WindowFpsTest.zip](https://github.com/user-attachments/files/20132743/WindowFpsTest.zip)
